get.description:
Return a list of workflow permanent logs. Any resource using workflow should have log of activities and events related to the workflow.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_type]
parameters.description: Filter log(s) with matching workflowed object type

parameters.name: filters[workflowed_object_id]
parameters.description: Filter log(s) with matching workflowed object id

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

ball_in_court_duration.description: How long the assignee was responsible prior to acting

comments.description: Comments provided by the assignee when acting in the workflow

performed_by.description: Name of the user performing the activity

workflowed_object_type.example: The workflowed_object_type filter param must be provided

workflowed_object_id.example: The workflowed_object_id filter param must be provided

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/workflow_permanent_logs?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bworkflowed_object_type%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bworkflowed_object_id%5D=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
